inferredGeometry.disclaimer: The following are visual modeling estimates, not manufacturer CAD or measured engineering dimensions.
inferredGeometry.layout: Two central carbon-fibre booms slope from the upper fuselage to the left and right longitudinal motor tubes. Four wedge-shaped feet extend below the motors. The central boom and smaller linkage rod form the articulating landing assembly.
inferredGeometry.motorGridEstimate: Official top-view diagram has front motor span approximately 201 pixels, rear span 149 pixels, front-to-rear span 147 pixels. Scaling the opposite motor diagonal to 685 mm gives front x approximately +/-301 mm, rear x approximately +/-223 mm, fore/aft z approximately +/-220 mm. Front is the X9 camera side. Not a perfect rectangle; longitudinal motor tubes splay outward toward the front.
inferredGeometry.body: Narrow matte grey shell is tall at the front FPV camera and slopes down toward the rear battery pair. Large open side cutouts expose pivot cylinders and the inner mechanism; avoid replacing openings with painted black panels.
inferredGeometry.materials: Fine woven dark carbon boom/tube material, satin grey outer shell, matte dark battery panels and feet, machined black motor rings, reflective coated camera optics, subtle red/green status details.
inferredGeometry.camera: Large multi-sided X9 housing has side pitch cylinders and a single offset metal fork underneath the yaw cylinder. Cylindrical DL lens projects forward; should not resemble a Mini camera or rectangular action camera.
